arguments.text: 8 km race, out-and-back legs of 1250 m. Pacer sets effort from the pod reserve. My jobs: (1) drag/weed: watch local push dropping within a leg; after any clear_rudder check that speed recovered; (2) pod drift: watch pod power against heart rate and against boat-model power; if the pod drifts, set pod_gain so the pacer reads true effort; (3) critical power check from heart rate: steady effort below CP gives a heart-rate plateau, above CP it keeps climbing; record a belief, do not fake pod_gain; (4) radio/course changes: set_race_distance and tell the paddler; (5) near 800 m to go check the reserve and the finish rule. Baseline: boat/pod power share about 0.67-0.71 (pre-race 115/170).

arguments.text: 22.2 min (1332 s), leg 4 back: push_local -0.23 to -0.25 at 178 W, GPS 2.86 (leg 2 back was -0.08, GPS 3.05 @174). End of leg 3 out was +0.24. So push of current/wind ~0.24 now, ~0.13 on legs 1-2, near 0.03 mid leg 3 (850-1000 s): a wind/current that died then came back stronger. The 875 s heavy feeling = tailwind dropping, NOT weed (both directions move opposite ways). Weed would drop push_local in BOTH directions; a drop on a back leg is the stronger sign. Pod reserve 23% falling ~3%/min at 178 W; sustainable 174.6 W; empties ~450 m before finish at current power.
